declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. FIR 18/2024 (Srikalahasti I) includes IPC 365 (kidnapping/abducting with intent to secretly confine, max 7 years) and qualifies. FIR 138/2023 cites an SC/ST (POA) Act section and FIR 303/2021 cites a Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act section; the maximum sentence attached to those specific clauses is not clear from the affidavit text, so they were not counted as serious. The remaining 12 cases involve IPC 143/188/269/270/271/283/341/353/506 with maximum sentences under 5 years. Zero convictions.
